meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 每当 Claude 成功执行编辑操作（如修改代码、写入文件等）后，该技能会自动检查文件中的注释质量。如果发现注释有问题，它会向 Claude 发送阻止性反馈，要求 Claude 在继续下一步之前修正或说明被标记的注释。
howto.when: 在 Claude 成功执行编辑操作（如 apply_patch、write、edit 等）后触发，当自动评论检查器发现注释问题时，会反馈给 Claude。

say.text: 检查我最近的代码修改，确保注释没问题。
say.note: 触发技能，自动检查注释。

say.text: 如果注释有警告，先修复再继续下一步。
say.note: 让 Claude 优先处理注释问题。

howto.what_en: After Claude successfully performs an edit operation (e.g., applying a patch, writing a file, editing code), this skill automatically checks the quality of comments in the file. If issues are found, it sends blocking feedback asking Claude to fix or explain the flagged comments before proceeding.
howto.when_en: Triggered after Claude successfully executes edit operations like apply_patch, write, edit, etc. When the comment checker reports a warning, feedback is sent to Claude.

say_en.text: Check my recent code changes for comment issues.
If there are comment warnings, fix them first before continuing.
